name: tripwire
description: Holds a destructive Bash command before it runs, shows what it would destroy, and waits for you to run it once, block it, or allow its rule for the session.

extra_patterns.title: Extra patterns
extra_patterns.description: More regular expressions (JavaScript syntax) that trip the wire, one per entry.

hold_seconds.title: Hold timeout
hold_seconds.description: Seconds to wait for your answer before the command is blocked.
